narr: A line of showers and thunderstorms along a gust front, well ahead of a cold front, produced localized heavy rain and flash flooding. Showers and thunderstorms trained over the same areas for a period of time which led to excessive rainfall.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding and led to Vandiford Thomas Road to be closed near Taylor Road.
Mount Herman Church Road was closed near North Carolina Highway 91 due to flash flooding.
